description: Meta-search across millions of openly licensed images, audio and media.
description_zh: 跨数百万开放许可图片、音频与媒体的聚合搜索。

entries.name: Openverse
entries.description: Search 800M+ Creative Commons images and audio from across the web.
entries.description_zh: 检索全网 8 亿+ 知识共享图片与音频。
entries.notes: Always check the license shown for each individual result.
entries.notes_zh: 以每条结果展示的许可为准。

entries.name: Every Stock Photo
entries.description: Search free photos from many public domain and CC sources.
entries.description_zh: 跨多个公有领域与 CC 图源搜索免费照片。

entries.name: Wikimedia Commons
entries.description: 100M+ freely licensed media files, strong for editorial and historical content.
entries.description_zh: 1 亿+ 自由许可媒体文件，编辑与历史类内容尤其丰富。

entries.name: The Public Domain Review
entries.description: Curated essays and collections rediscovering public-domain treasures.
entries.description_zh: 精选公有领域珍品的策展站点，附背景文章。
entries.notes: A discovery/curation site, not a stock host; check each work.
entries.notes_zh: 属发现/策展站点而非素材托管；请逐件核对作品状态。

entries.name: DPLA
entries.description: Digital Public Library of America: millions of items from US libraries and museums.
entries.description_zh: 美国数字公共图书馆：聚合全美图书馆与博物馆的数百万条目。

entries.name: Europeana
entries.description: European cultural heritage: artworks, photos and sounds from 3,000+ institutions.
entries.description_zh: 欧洲文化遗产：3,000+ 机构的艺术品、照片与声音。
